name: Growless Cave
summary: In frigid Growless Cave, mountain yetis roam the cavern in the Alterac Mountains. The cave also holds the Flame of Uzel, a ceremonial pyre tied to Helcular's dark necromancy.

sections.title: A Den of Beasts and Dark Magic
sections.body: Territorial mountain yetis roam Growless Cave in the crags above Alterac's foothills. Travelers on the treacherous slopes avoid its entrance, especially when Skhowl, a notorious yeti, prowls outside. The cave holds more than danger from the beasts. Within it stands the Flame of Uzel, an arcane brazier left by the human mage Helcular. Before his death, Helcular meant to use the pyre in a dark ritual to become a lich. Its foul warmth once drew Frostmaw, a massive predator, from the frozen wastes.

faq.q: What creatures live in Growless Cave?
faq.answer: Wild mountain yetis native to Alterac live in Growless Cave. Skhowl, a dangerous and rare yeti, sometimes wanders just outside its entrance.

faq.q: What is the Flame of Uzel?
faq.answer: The Flame of Uzel is a ceremonial pyre established by Helcular, a former Dalaran mage turned necromancer. He made it for a forbidden ritual meant to transform him into an undying lich.
Frostmaw is a massive, exceptionally fierce yeti roaming the Alterac peaks. Burning fresh meat on the Flame of Uzel once lured the ravenous beast to the cavern.
Adventurers brave the cave to hunt dangerous yetis for their pelts or to pursue the lingering necromantic artifacts tied to Helcular's legacy in Alterac.

angles.text: For Forsaken aiding Helcular's vengeance, the cave holds grim significance. His dark rites and relics remain scattered across fallen Alterac.
The Flame of Uzel's remnants warn mages of the peril of turning Kirin Tor wizardry toward necromancy.
